messages:
Priya: Quick check-in: release announcement scheduled Fri. We need final changelog, public docs link, a 1-line bench stat for the hero, and confirmation of the webinar demo script. Also confirm deploy timing so we can set the embargo.

Jon: I'll submit the changelog PR today with rollout + rollback notes. Tentative rollout: 15m canary -> 60m staged -> full. Rollback if p95 regression >7%. Need SRE approval for the canary slot.

Marta: Docs draft is ready internally. I need the final model name and one sample request/response to publish public examples. Will add SDK snippets after you confirm the sample.

Theo: Webinar plan: 18m product + 22m demo (stream + tool call), 20m live Q&A. DevRel needs happy-path demo script + fallback script (quantized model) by Wednesday noon. Also request a short list of key talking points for the hero bench line.

Ava: Marketing wants the messaging focused: deterministic latency, lower per-token cost, safer rollouts. Keep deep technical details in the blog. We need a tight bench blurb 99something like "~14% median speedup and ~11% token cost reduction" 9if that matches perf.

Jon: Perf quickline: median latency ~14% lower on our standard chat trace; token cost ~11% lower with default batching. I'll link the perf run in the changelog PR. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/972

Priya: Good. @Jon confirm SRE slot please. Also what's the embargo window? Marketing needs that to schedule press.

Jon: SRE confirmed canary at 2026-05-07T18:00:00Z (canary 15m). DeployBot will handle staged cutover. Embargo: press embargo lifts 6 hours after full rollout per product request.

DeployBot: Deploy scheduled for release v1.15.0 at 2026-05-07T18:00:00Z (canary 15m, staged 60m). Rollback trigger: p95 regression >7%. Link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/ops/13021

Marta: I'll publish the public docs page after changelog merges. Draft link (internal): https://redwood.docs.internal/drafts/v1.15.0. Please paste the final curl + SDK snippets here.

Theo: Demo scripts due Wed 12:00 PT. DevRel will rehearse Thurs. Please include an example of streaming partial outputs and a tool call that integrates with a mock ticketing API.

Priya: Action items: Jon finalize changelog and add perf links, Marta publish public docs after merge and post snippets, Theo deliver demo scripts, Ava finalize hero copy with bench blurb. Marketing will prepare landing page with consent text and lead routing to Sales (real-time). Everyone ack? :thumbsup: 

Jon: ack

Marta: ack

Theo: ack

Ava: ack

Priya: Note: canary start delayed +10min; DeployBot updated schedule. Also if any perf alert >7% on p95 fires we abort canary and notify comms within 5 minutes.

DeployBot: Updated deploy schedule: canary start 2026-05-07T18:10:00Z.

Priya: Thanks all. I'll draft the press embargo email and share the landing page link when ready.

Jon: Adding watch alerts and rollback playbook now.
